name: Ischgl
kurzbeschreibung: World-renowned winter and summer lifestyle resort Ischgl in the Paznaun thrills with the Silvretta Arena, Idalp, and Ischgl Skyfly.
beschreibung:
Overview

The vibrant alpine destination of Ischgl lies at an elevation of 1,377 meters in the sunny Paznaun valley in western Tyrol, enjoying global renown as a premier winter sports paradise and alpine lifestyle hotspot. Together with the Swiss duty-free enclave of Samnaun, Ischgl forms the cross-border "Silvretta Arena" – one of the largest, most modern, and most snow-sure ski resorts in the Alps, featuring 239 kilometers of groomed slopes and 45 lifts. Famous worldwide are the "Top of the Mountain Concerts," where international music superstars open and close the winter season on the Idalp stage. In summer, Ischgl has evolved into a world-class outdoor hub, attracting mountain bikers, trail runners, climbers, and hikers with panoramas of the Silvretta and Verwall mountain ranges.

Route & Requirements

From the town center, three high-capacity gondolas – the Silvrettabahn, Fimbabahn, and Pardatschgratbahn – whisk hikers and mountain bikers comfortably up to altitudes between 2,300 and 2,600 meters. The centerpiece of summer activities on the mountain is the "Vider Truja Adventure Park" at Idalp reservoir, featuring barefoot sensory paths, Kneipp water circuits, and play areas for children. For ambitious hikers, the high-altitude Smugglers' Trail to Samnaun or the climb of the Flimspitze (2,928 m) provide unforgettable alpine days (requiring surefootedness and sturdy hiking boots). For adrenaline enthusiasts, the "Ischgl Skyfly" zip line hurtles riders across the Kitzloch gorge back down to the valley at speeds up to 85 km/h. Mountain paths and lift stations are clearly signposted and accessible.

Visit & Arrival

Lifts in the Silvretta Arena operate in summer from late June to mid-October daily from 08:30 to 16:30; winter runs from late November to early May. With the Silvretta Card Premium provided to overnight guests, all cable cars throughout the Paznaun and Samnaun are free and unlimited. Drivers arrive via the A12 Inntal motorway or S16 expressway (exit Pians) and follow the B188 Paznauntalstraße to Ischgl. Rail passengers arrive at Landeck-Zams station, with frequent VVT buses running directly to Ischgl.

Tips

Book a ride on the thrilling Ischgl Skyfly and glide through the canyon on a two-kilometer cable flight back to the valley after your mountain hike. Combine your hike with a stroll across the Swiss border into duty-free Samnaun for shopping and dining.
preis: Ascent & descent Silvrettabahn adults approx. €36.00; Silvretta Card Premium free for overnight guests
oeffnungszeiten: Summer season late June to mid-October daily 08:30 to 16:30; winter ski season late November to early May
